name: Mount Bohemia
generated_description:
Mount Bohemia rises to 1,437 feet in Michigan. The Mount Bohemia Trail covers 1.4 miles round trip (out-and-back) with about 59 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 47.41289, -87.9893 (tap for driving directions). Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

Late May through October is the main season. Snow and ice linger into spring and return early in fall at this latitude and elevation; in winter this becomes a different, more serious undertaking requiring traction devices and warm layers.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 0.5 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Looking to link objectives or plan a weekend? Nearby summits include Mount Houghton, Gratiot Mountain and Mount Horace Greeley — each has its own guide on this site.

faqs.answer: It's rated Easy using the National Park Service difficulty formula (1.4 miles round trip, 59 ft of gain — about 50 ft of climbing per mile). The elevation profile on this page shows exactly where the steep sections fall.

faqs.answer: The trailhead is at 47.41289, -87.9893 in Michigan. Use the driving-directions link in the Getting There section above, and note that parking at popular trailheads fills early on weekends.

faqs.question: Are dogs allowed on the Mount Bohemia trail?
faqs.answer: Rules vary by land manager — national parks often prohibit dogs on trails, while most national forests allow them on leash. Check with the managing agency for this trail before bringing your dog, and pack out waste.

faqs.question: When is the best time to hike Mount Bohemia?
faqs.answer: Late May through October for snow-free hiking. Check a summit point forecast before you go — conditions up high differ from the trailhead.

faqs.question: How tall is Mount Bohemia?
faqs.answer: Mount Bohemia stands at 1,437 feet (438 meters) in Michigan.
